newsitem.title: USA: Hudson Hotels buys 12 hotels for $61 million.
newsitem.headline: Hudson Hotels buys 12 hotels for $61 million.

text.p: Hudson Hotels Corp. said Tuesday it has signed a definitive agreement to buy 12 hotels for $61 million from SB Motel Corp.
The price includes a $55 million cash payment, $3 million in Hudson common stock and $3 million in short-term notes.
SB Motel is a subsidiary of Salomon Brothers Holding Co. Inc., the parent company of Salomon Brothers Inc.
The acquisition includes eight Fairfield Inns by Marriott and four Cricket Inns with 1,533 guest rooms in Georgia, North Carolina, South Carolina and Virginia.
This acquisition will bring Hudson Hotels' management portfolio to 32 properties, of which the Rochester, N.Y.-based company will own equity interests in 30.
The deal is expected to close before the end of the year, subject to final due diligence. Hudson's stock rose 37.5 cents to $7.25 on Nasdaq in late trading.
